$description: Design tokens of Pico Reforged (W3C Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10), generated from src/tokens, src/themes and src/extras by scripts/generate-ai.ts. See ai/README.md.

color.$description: Semantic colors of the page. $value is the light scheme, the dark scheme is in $extensions dark. The primary tokens alias the default theme (azure).

muted-color.$description: Muted text color for secondary information.

muted-border-color.$description: Border color of separators and quiet surfaces.

secondary-inverse.$description: Secondary text color on a filled background.

contrast-inverse.$description: Contrast text color on a filled background.

form-element-invalid-border-color.$description: Form element color in the invalid state.

form-element-invalid-active-border-color.$description: Form element color in the invalid state.

form-element-invalid-focus-color.$description: Form element color in the invalid state.

form-element-valid-border-color.$description: Form element color in the valid state.

form-element-valid-active-border-color.$description: Form element color in the valid state.

form-element-valid-focus-color.$description: Form element color in the valid state.

primary-inverse.$description: Primary text color on a filled background.

dimension.$description: Spacing, radius, border and outline sizes, in rem.

border-radius.$description: Corner radius of controls and cards.

scrollbar-width.$description: Scrollbar width that a modal compensates for.

number.$description: Unitless values: line height and opacities.

font-family.$description: Font stacks. The stack of a token that ends in an emoji stack has it inlined.

font-family-emoji.$description: Emoji font stack, appended to the text stacks.

transition.$description: Transition shorthand used by interactive elements.

shadow.$description: Box shadows as DTCG shadow layers. $value is the light scheme.

button-box-shadow.$description: Box shadow of buttons and groups.

button-hover-box-shadow.$description: Box shadow of buttons and groups.

group-box-shadow.$description: Box shadow of buttons and groups.

group-box-shadow-focus-with-button.$description: Box shadow of buttons and groups.

group-box-shadow-focus-with-input.$description: Box shadow of buttons and groups.

palette.$description: The OKLCH palette behind pico.colors.css, one token per hue and step, plus the main color of each hue.

red.$description: Main color of the red hue.

pink.$description: Main color of the pink hue.

fuchsia.$description: Main color of the fuchsia hue.

purple.$description: Main color of the purple hue.

azure.$description: Main color of the azure hue.

cyan.$description: Main color of the cyan hue.

green.$description: Main color of the green hue.

lime.$description: Main color of the lime hue.

yellow.$description: Main color of the yellow hue.

amber.$description: Main color of the amber hue.

orange.$description: Main color of the orange hue.

sand.$description: Main color of the sand hue.

grey.$description: Main color of the grey hue.

zinc.$description: Main color of the zinc hue.

slate.$description: Main color of the slate hue.

theme.$description: One group per built-in theme with the primary color set it defines. Use these to read or build a theme.
